name: Payment connection pool exhaustion
query: Payment API latency is high because database connections are exhausted.

name: Payment requests waiting for connections
query: Checkout calls time out while waiting to acquire a database connection.

name: Payment database CPU overload
query: Payment transactions fail when slow queries push database CPU above normal levels.

name: Authentication worker memory pressure
query: Login requests fail while authentication workers restart after reaching their memory limit.

name: Order API incompatible release
query: Order creation returns server errors after a dependency change was deployed.

name: Payment latency after release
query: The latest payment application version increased request processing time.

name: Notification queue rate limiting
query: Email delivery is delayed because provider throttling causes retries and backlog.

name: Search cluster node unavailable
query: Search returns service unavailable responses while a node is down and shards rebalance.

name: Inventory event consumer lag
query: Inventory values are stale because the read model consumer is behind source events.

name: Carrier integration timeout
query: Shipping labels time out because the external carrier responds slowly and workers are full.

name: Unrelated disk failure
query: A host disk failed and the filesystem became read-only, preventing local writes.

name: Unrelated DNS certificate issue
query: A TLS certificate expired on a public DNS provider and browsers reject the site.

name: Catalog stale cached prices
query: Some product prices remain outdated because cache invalidation messages were lost.

name: Order consumer connection retries
query: Order status events stop processing after repeated database connection acquisition failures.

name: Payment gateway transient errors
query: A payment provider returns intermittent 502 errors while local health checks still pass.

name: Image upload limit mismatch
query: Large uploads receive a 413 response from the reverse proxy before the app sees them.
